topic: Don't waste water: Mano learns to close the dripping tap.

episode.title: Mano aur Sheru: Tap Tap Paani!

shots.narration: ارے، نل سے پانی کون ٹپکا رہا ہے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful Pakistani courtyard beneath a neem tree, low brass tap dripping above a stone basin, rounded family-film 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano, a white kitten with orange patches, bright blue eyes and a tiny bell on a red ribbon, peers at a falling drop.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, sparkling droplet, curious blue eyes.

shots.narration: مانو نے پنجہ بڑھایا تو قطرہ چھپاک سے گرا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 close view of the low courtyard tap and shallow stone basin, colourful family-film 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano catches a falling drop on her raised paw.
shots.mood: Playful expression, tiny bright splash, soft golden light.

shots.narration: [giggles] مانو بولی، یہ تو مزے کا کھیل ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 beside the dripping courtyard tap, neem leaves overhead, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano bats at another falling droplet.
shots.mood: Mischievous smile, bouncing bell, cheerful colours.

shots.narration: شیرو آیا تو اس نے بھی ٹپکتا نل دیکھا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 Pakistani courtyard with a low dripping tap, stone basin and open house doorway, family-film 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru, a brown desi dog with a white chest, pointy ears and a green collar, approaches the tap beside Mano.
shots.mood: Attentive ears, gentle faces, warm courtyard light.

shots.narration: اس نے قطروں کے نیچے ایک خالی پیالہ رکھ دیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 close view beneath the low courtyard tap, small plain blue bowl and stone basin, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru slides the empty blue bowl beneath the dripping spout.
shots.mood: Calm demonstration, Mano watching closely, clear view of the bowl.

shots.narration: [surprised] کچھ دیر بعد پیالے میں اتنا پانی جمع ہوگیا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 same courtyard tap, blue bowl now half-filled with water beneath the spout, family-film 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano leans over the bowl to inspect the collected water.
shots.mood: Wide blue eyes, visible water surface, soft reflected sunlight.

shots.narration: شیرو بولا، مانو، پانی یوں ضائع نہیں کرنا چاہیے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 beside the low brass tap and half-filled blue bowl in the Pakistani courtyard, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru points one paw toward the dripping spout.
shots.mood: Kind steady gaze, Mano listening, gentle afternoon colours.

shots.narration: مانو نے دونوں پنجوں سے نل کی ٹونٹی گھمائی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 close view of an accessible low brass tap with a rounded handle, blue bowl beneath, family-film 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano turns the tap handle closed with both front paws.
shots.mood: Focused kitten face, Sheru watching supportively, bright clear detail.

shots.narration: [excited] واہ، اب نل سے پانی نہیں ٹپک رہا!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 close view of the closed brass spout above the collected water, colourful courtyard background, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano holds her paw beneath the dry spout.
shots.mood: Proud smile, dry paw, Sheru's approving expression.

shots.narration: مانو نے جمع پانی ننھے پودے کو دے دیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 courtyard corner beside the neem tree, small leafy plant in a terracotta pot, family-film 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano tips the blue bowl to pour its water onto the plant's soil.
shots.mood: Gentle care, darkening damp soil, fresh green leaves.

shots.narration: تبھی چھت پر ایک رنگین پتنگ آ کر ٹھہری۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 Pakistani house rooftop above the courtyard, low parapet and distant colourful mohalla rooftops, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: A bright diamond-shaped kite settles flat on the rooftop.
shots.mood: Soft breeze, sunny sky, colourful ribbon tail.

shots.narration: [excited] پانی بچائیں؛ اگلی بار دیکھیں گے، چھت کی پتنگ کس کی ہے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16 wide Pakistani courtyard with closed tap in foreground and colourful kite visible on the rooftop above, family-film 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano and Sheru look up toward the rooftop kite together.
shots.mood: Friendly smiles, curious upward gazes, warm sunlight.

episode.endHook: اگلی بار چھت پر یہ رنگین پتنگ کس کی ہوگی؟
episode.description: مانو کو صحن میں ٹپکتے نل کے ساتھ کھیلنا اچھا لگتا ہے، مگر شیرو اسے پانی بچانا سکھاتا ہے۔ دیکھیے دونوں دوست مل کر پانی کا ضیاع کیسے روکتے ہیں۔
